entries.wording: Paket aún no retira este pedido
entries.note: Titled Por Retirar: the shop has booked the order and Paket has not collected it yet.
Titled Retirado: Paket collected the order from the shop.
Titled En tránsito, but its sentence and the page's rail step, En reparto, put the parcel on its delivery round.
The page's headline for the progress alert fallido: Paket will try again or the shop will get in touch.
The page's headline for the progress alert no_recibido: the shop cancelled the order or never handed it to Paket.

entries.wording: Tu pedido va de vuelta a la tienda
entries.note: The page's headline for the progress alert devolviendo: a return to the shop under way.

entries.wording: Tu pedido volvió a la tienda
entries.note: The page's headline for the progress alert devuelto: the parcel is back at the shop.
The page's headline for the progress alert consultar, which sends the reader to the shop and says nothing of the parcel; the rows set the stage.
The page's headline when the reply marks the parcel as lost (extraviado.es_extraviado): Paket is looking for it.
